task: Reduce benign overestimation using one fixed monotone median calibration of v8.
source: Previously unjudged stored real articles, not newly downloaded.
development: 1043 previously stored v8 development OOF predictions and their AI references. No v8 final-test labels used to fit calibration.
method: Family-balanced weighted median isotonic regression, fixed quantile .5; no parameter search.
primary: Fresh real-article MAE against same-session AI full-body judgments; descriptive small-sample result.
guards: MAE and within10 must not worsen against both v5 and v8; recall at reference >=30 must not worsen when present.
stop: One model, one 14-article audit; no tuning after opening predictions.
deployment: No whole-corpus promotion from 14 AI judgments. v9 may be offered as experimental calibrated v8 only.
reference: One AI evaluator; no independent human truth or risk probability.
